name: ReaperMCP
description: Reviews destructive REAPER project-editing tools: batch track deletion, track template deletion, and clearing every tempo marker. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep track_delete_batch, track_template_delete, and tempo_clear_all on Review unless this device needs unattended batch deletes.

project_undo only reverses the most recent tracked change and needs no review gate — every ReaperMCP mutation already records its own named undo step, so undoing is how a mistake gets fixed, not how one is made.
